description: This file is a C header file (.h) defining interfaces for the RT2880 MDIO driver, including function prototypes and include guards.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_link_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts the MDIO link settings for the RT2880 device.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_read
methods.description: Reads a register from the MDIO bus for the specified PHY address and register.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a register on the MDIO bus for the specified PHY address.

methods.name: rt2880_port_init
methods.description: Initializes a network port for the RT2880 device.
